na96cba8271.headline: Lebanon: A Buyers' Market - Fouad Gemayel
na96cba8271.summary: Lebanon's economy is expected to grow 0% in the first half of the year amid rising interest rates, according to the Governor of the Bank of Lebanon.
na96cba8271.why: Lebanon's economic stagnation and rising rates signal financial stress in a country already facing fiscal and political challenges.

n421c11bc76.headline: Barbosa announces audits and uncovers debt of 44 billion pesos
n421c11bc76.summary: After taking office, the Morena party governor announced audits revealing a debt of 44 billion pesos from previous administrations in Mexico.
n421c11bc76.why: Large public debt revelations can affect fiscal policy, credit ratings, and investor confidence in regional governments.
